description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

B4Corp is seeking an Expert Web Developer to provide end-to-end digital accessibility expertise for its client. The role integrates accessibility throughout the software development lifecycle and reviews, audits, and enforces compliance across UX design, UI development, and application engineering workflows.
Software Engineer integrating digital accessibility throughout the SDLC and auditing and enforcing UX, UI, and application engineering compliance

Responsibilities:
• The Customer requires contractor support to provide end-to-end accessibility expertise, integrating digital accessibility into every phase of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), reviewing, auditing and enforcing accessibility compliance across UX design, UI development, and application engineering workflows

Requirements:
• Position Requires a Top Secret (TS/SCI) Clearance with a Polygraph
• Developmental (0-2 years' experience)
• Full Performance (3-5 years' experience)
• Senior (6-10 years' experience)
• Expert (11-15 years' experience)
• SME (16+ years' experience)
• Demonstrated experience with accessibility testing, with an ability to analyze complex technical issues related to accessibility and provide solutions
• Demonstrated ability to document accessibility compliance efforts, findings, and recommendations
• Demonstrated experience with Section 508 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973 (29 U.S.C. 794d), WCAG 2.1 AA (or higher) standards, Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 39.2 standards
• Demonstrated testing proficiency and expertise with assistive technologies including JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver, and ZoomText
• Demonstrated experience with User interfaces (UI) design and development
• Demonstrated experience with principles of User Experience (UX) design with a focus on accessibility, User Interface (UI) development best practices for accessibility, and familiarity with design tools like Figma and Adobe XO
• Demonstrated experience integrating digital accessibility into every phase of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), to include requirements gathering, design, development, testing, deployment, maintenance
• Demonstrated experience coordinating between design, engineering, and product stakeholders
• Demonstrated experience with reviewing and auditing digital products for accessibility compliance and an understanding of how to enforce accessibility standards across different development workflows
• Demonstrated experience or ability to provide training on accessibility standards, guidelines, and best practices to development teams and other stakeholders
